intermediate.name: Tis u Blatna
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Tis u Blatna (93.3 km)

story: Early attacks shaped the opening kilometres before a four-rider breakaway formed, with Pepijn Reinderink taking two of three mountain sprints to secure the mountains jersey for stage 2. Ineos and Modern Adventure led the chase, catching the leaders with 20km to go. A late attack failed, and Riley Sheehan won the reduced sprint from Ben Turner, with Romet Pajur third.
